fallbackBody: Open the app to see it.

credential_counter_regression.title: Security check needed
credential_counter_regression.body: A passkey reported an unexpected sign-in count. Check your passkeys and remove any you don't recognise.

push_job_stuck.title: Notification delivery stuck
push_job_stuck.body: A notification stopped sending for 10 minutes and was marked failed. Check the notification jobs.

super_passkey_added.title: New passkey on a Super Admin account
super_passkey_added.body: A passkey was just added to a Super Admin account. If this wasn't you, remove it in Account now.

payment_request.title: UPI change requested
payment_request.body: A masjid asked to change its UPI payment details. Review it in Payment approvals.

payment_approved.title: UPI change approved
payment_approved.body: Your new UPI details were approved. They go live after the waiting period.

payment_rejected.title: UPI change not approved
payment_rejected.body: Your UPI change was not approved. Open Payment to see why.

payment_active.title: New UPI details are live
payment_active.body: Your new UPI details are now shown to everyone. Followers were told.
